purpose: Public Technocore DID guide and FLOP contribution proof

signed_messages.text: Hello from a new Technocore contributor. I am preparing a useful public resource for agents and developers.

I published a Technocore contribution: https://github.com/klopp78/technocore-flop-did-guide. It helps people understand Technocore DID participation, signed messages, public contribution proof, and safe evidence handling.
I shared the Technocore FLOP contribution publicly on X: https://x.com/Galax2u/status/2092444291918622890. This links the public GitHub guide, DID proof, and Technocore contribution record.
